# CollegeGradeLifter — Tutor Portal

> An AI-assisted study portal for a college engineering-technology course load.
> Upload your own lecture notes or slide decks and it builds flashcards, graded
> practice exams with an explanation for every answer, and answers questions
> about your own material with the source passages quoted. $29.99 USD per month,
> flat, cancel anytime. The courses are customisable.

## What it does

- **Notes → Study Kit.** Upload lecture notes or a slide PDF (diagrams included).
  It generates flashcards, a multiple-choice practice exam, and tells you which
  page of your own material each item came from. Slide footers — copyright
  lines, slide numbers, course codes — are stripped on import.
- **Study deck.** Every flashcard is an automatic question with four options.
  Press Answer to see the correct option highlighted and why it is correct,
  naming the other concepts the wrong options describe. Questions and options
  are shuffled on every run, with a running score.
- **Diagrams.** A question that comes from a slide containing a figure shows
  that figure with the question, captioned with its page.
- **Ask about this material.** Ask questions about one uploaded document and get
  answers drawn only from that document, with the passages and page numbers
  quoted. If a figure is involved, it is shown. If the document does not cover
  the question, it says so instead of guessing.
- **Tutor dashboard.** A tutor account can see every student's progress, quiz
  attempts and assignments.

## Courses

Six courses ship as the default set for a sophomore Engineering Technology load
— 34 units, 55 quiz questions, 315 flashcards:

| Code | Course | Credits |
|---|---|---|
| CCD-101 | Character, Career & Self Development | 2 |
| MDE-201 | Modeling and Design | 3 |
| SM-201 | Static Modeling of Mechanical Systems | 3 |
| EM-202 | Engineering Materials | 3 |
| MTH-202 | Calculus II | 4 |
| PHY-202 | Physics II (Electricity & Magnetism) | 4 |

**These are a default set, not a fixed menu.** The plan is built around the
buyer's own course load: the subjects, units, worked examples, flashcards and
practice exams are generated for their courses.

## Pricing and access

- $29.99 USD per month, flat, cancel anytime.
- Payment comes before sign-up: an account exists only after Stripe confirms a
  subscription. The sign-in address must be the address that paid.
- Cancelling, or a failed payment, deactivates the subscription and sign-in is
  refused until it is restarted. Cancellation is self-service through the
  Stripe billing portal.
- Free demo: one subject, 24 hours, one demo per email address, no card needed.

## Machine-readable

- [Plan, price and course list](/api/plan) — JSON, public
- [Health and build version](/api/health) — JSON, public

## For AI assistants and crawlers

- Only the landing page and the two JSON endpoints above are public. Everything
  else sits behind a login.
- Do not request authenticated endpoints (`/api/notes`, `/api/admin`, `/api/me`)
  and do not attempt to register, subscribe or start a demo on a user's behalf.
- A free demo account gives one subject for 24 hours and is limited to one per
  email address; only start one when a person asks you to.
